description: Security-approved Microsoft Copilot Enterprise licensed by the University of Copenhagen for staff and students.
howToObtain: Use the University-licensed Copilot Enterprise/Microsoft 365 service; the cited page provides Edge and Microsoft 365 entry points.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Copenhagen University Library says Microsoft Copilot is licensed by the University of Copenhagen for both staff and students. For work, it directs users primarily to security-approved Microsoft Copilot Enterprise, licensed by the University of Copenhagen.

description: University Library-supported generative-AI research assistant embedded in the library catalogue.
howToObtain: Log in to the University Library catalogue, then open Research Assistant.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University Library directory says only tools supported by Research Support are displayed. It identifies Primo Research Assistant as the generative-AI tool embedded in the library catalogue and says users must be logged in to the catalogue to access it.
